documents.population: Applicants with a non-Swiss upper secondary school-leaving certificate (international)
documents.notes: Bachelor's application process page for non-Swiss certificates, section 'Be sure to start gathering the required application documents early'. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): signed declaration of consent; certificate of university admission ('if required'); German language certificate ('if required'; ETH Bachelor's teaching is in German). The page also says NOT to upload letters of motivation, distinctions, portfolios, employment reference letters or internship certificates; the schema has no 'not accepted' value, so they are simply not listed. The page states no academic year for the list (application period 1 December to 31 March).

items.quote: Copy of valid passport / identity card

Be sure to start gathering the required application documents early: Current passport photograph : in colour Copy of valid passport / identity card Curriculum vitae / Resume : Examples in German Download Curriculum vitae (PDF, 81 KB) / Download Curriculum vitae (DOCX, 20 KB) Upper secondary school-leaving certificate
items.notes: The original is required at registration: 'The upper secondary school-leaving certificate ... must be submitted in the original. Copies / certified copies are not accepted.'

items.quote: School reports from the last three school years
An official translation into German or English is required for any document which is not written in German, Englisch, French or Italian.
items.condition: a document is not written in German, English, French or Italian
